objective: Select informative, admissible experiment arrays under exact resource and evidence constraints.
context: Four finite planning families; producer proposes, LDT sorter recommends, operator authorizes, independent steward scores. OOD size transfer is distinct from semantic family transfer.

steps.name: Generate candidate
steps.description: Define a proposed experiment and required controls.

steps.name: Select array
steps.description: Optimize utility or characterize Pareto uncertainty.

steps.name: Authorize execution
steps.description: Describe proposal-only boundary and owner approval.

steps.name: Score evidence
steps.description: Specify exact grading, root custody and promotion limits.

specific_questions.prompt: Solve a small concurrent experiment selection example with summed RAM, slots and visit constraints; prove optimality.
Construct interval-valued Pareto comparisons, including an unresolved case.
Give a prefix-DAG validity check and a counterexample involving a forward dependency.
